features.name: Size
features.description: Small: +1 size AC, +1 size attack, -1 CMB and CMD, +4 size Stealth.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 20-foot land speed. Hover a few feet above ground through Auto-Float; losing Float allows only 5-foot crawl movement per move action.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts speaking Common, Lambkin. High-Intelligence options: Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, Orc.

features.name: Auto-Float
features.description: Always under Float; without Float may only crawl 5 feet per move action. Dispel caster level equals character level and suppresses Float for 1 round. Anti-magic zones suppress Float until leaving.

effects.textValue: Always floating; dispel for one round, suppressed in antimagic; while absent crawling only at 5 feet per movement action

features.name: Magic Aptitude
features.description: +2 racial caster-level checks to overcome spell resistance; +2 racial dispel checks.

effects.textValue: +2 racial on CL checks against SR

features.name: Magick Focus
features.description: +2 racial concentration checks to cast spells defensively.

effects.textValue: +2 racial on concentration when casting defensively only

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far as a hume under dim light.

features.name: Academician
features.description: Choose ONE Knowledge skill for a +2 bonus. Replaces Magic Expert.

effects.textValue: +2 to one selected Knowledge skill, not all

features.name: Greater Magic Resistant
features.description: Spell resistance increases to 11 + character level. Replaces Magic Resistant and Magic Aptitude.

features.name: Inquisitive
features.description: +2 racial Disable Device and Escape Artist; replaces Magic Expert.

features.name: Magical Linguist
features.description: +1 DC spells with language-dependent descriptor or glyphs/symbols/magical writings, +2 racial saves against these spells. CHA >=11 grants each 1/day comprehend languages, message, read magic (CL = character level). Replaces Magic Aptitude.

effects.textValue: If CHA >= 11: 1/day each comprehend languages, message, read magic, caster level = character level

features.name: Polyglot
features.description: +2 racial Linguistics and it becomes class skill; additional ONE language of choice beyond Common/Lambkin and eligible bonus languages; replaces Magic Expert AND modifies Languages.

effects.textValue: Linguistics always class skill; retain existing Common and Lambkin; grant ONE extra chosen language

features.name: Practicality
features.description: Choose ONE Craft or Profession skill for +2 bonus; +2 Sense Motive and saves versus illusions; replaces Magic Expert and Magic Resistant.

effects.textValue: +2 one selected Craft or Profession skill only

choicePools.name: Bonus languages
choicePools.notes: Only eligible high-Intelligence choices. Count and repeated selections require standard language-rule audit.

choicePools.name: Academician Knowledge skill
choicePools.notes: Select exactly one Knowledge skill; catalog not yet mapped.

choicePools.name: Polyglot extra language
choicePools.notes: One additional chosen language, independent of high-INT bonus languages, which are retained.

choicePools.name: Practicality Craft or Profession
choicePools.notes: One Craft/Profession specialty only; skill specialization requires catalog.

alternateReplacements.description: Greater Magic Resistant: replaces Magic Resistant, Magic Aptitude.
Practicality: replaces Magic Expert, Magic Resistant.

favoredRewards.name: Lambkin Black Mage favored reward
favoredRewards.description: Gain one spell known from Black Mage list below highest spell level.

favoredRewards.description: One spell known Cleric list below highest available spell level.

favoredRewards.name: Lambkin Druid favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/2 daily use on a selected 1st-level domain power ordinarily used 3+WIS/day.

favoredRewards.name: Lambkin Geomancer favored reward
favoredRewards.description: One spell known Geomancer list below highest available spell level.

favoredRewards.name: Lambkin Necromancer favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1 bone commander skill rank, retained by replacement commander.

favoredRewards.name: Lambkin Summoner favored reward
favoredRewards.description: Reduce rounds to summon avatar by 1, minimum 1 round.

favoredRewards.name: Lambkin Time Mage favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/6 of an additional d3 on mote-boosted skill/ability check.
